title: Four Pistols for Trinity
description: A woman flees her home after finding her family slain by cutthroats and finds her way to a strange inn filled with rogues.

title: Two Crosses at Danger Pass
description: Killing leads to more killing, starting with the sheriff and an innocent prisoner.

title: The Man Who Cried For Revenge
description: A Civil War veteran loses his memory after being shot in the head. Upon returning to his hometown, he learns he has been declared a deserter, and a local judge offers him what appears to be a chance to clear his name.

title: Rattler Kid
description: An unjustly condemned soldier escapes and seeks justice as an outlaw.

title: Wanted
description: A sheriff goes on the run after he is unjustly accused of murder.

title: Poker with Pistols
description: After losing everything in a poker game and finding himself in debt, Lucas agrees to deliver a wagon to the town of Chamaco for a $5,000 payment. He soon finds himself in trouble with bandits, the town's local kingpin and a pretty saloon worker.

title: A Few Bullets More
description: Lawman Pat Garrett (Fausto Tozzi) pursues the legendary outlaw (Peter Lee Lawrence).

title: Winnetou & The Oil Prince
description: Apache Chief Winnetou and Old Surehand assist a wagon-train of settlers who are being threatened by the Oil Prince.

title: Bad Man's River
description: An outlaw and two con men attempt to relieve the Mexican government of $1 million. Once the scam is completed, they have to avoid the attentions of, amongst others, the Mexican army and Billy the Kid - all of whom are eager to claim the cash for themselves.

title: $100,000 for Ringo
description: Lee Barton arrives in a small town and is mistaken for a local killed during the Civil War. He soon battles with a local boss as they race to find a fortune left hidden by a Mexican general.

title: Two Brothers in Trinity
description: After inheriting a land plot in a dusty place called Trinity, the antagonistic half-brothers, Lester and Jesse, reunite to pursue different aspirations, only to find themselves neck-deep in trouble.

title: Gunfight at Red Sands
description: An avenger's (Richard Harrison) quest in the name of his father leads from Mexico to a duel in Texas.

title: Trinity in Eldorado
description: Bumbling con men wander through the West and do whatever they can to make fast money.

title: Requiem for A Gringo
description: An astronomer with a love of leopard skin returns to his hometown and immediately runs into trouble with a local gang. When his brother is subsequently murdered, he sets about to break up the gang by exploiting their individual weak points.

title: Lone and Angry Man
description: A man (Antonio De Teffe) joins a vicious gang of highwaymen after passing a deadly initiation. When the gang members suspect that he is a traitor, he turns on the degenerate men and seeks vengeance.

title: Renegade Riders
description: A gunman joins a gang of Confederate guerrillas to find a stockpile of stolen gold.

title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!
description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

title: The Desperado Trail
description: The fragile peace between whites and Apaches is threatened when it appears that Winnetou has killed a rival chief's son.

title: Brother Outlaw
description: A man is framed for bank robbery, prompting his brother to spring him from jail. Their search for the real culprits ends in a violent confrontation with a famed gunfighter.

title: Pistol for a Hundred Coffins
description: A Civil War veteran swears revenge when he returns home to find his family killed by a local gang.

title: Seven Guns for the MacGregors
description: Two Scots (Robert Woods, Paul Carter) and their five brothers fight bandits and a crooked sheriff on the Mexican border.

title: The Treasure of Silver Lake
description: A frontiersman and his American Indian comrade must stop bandits from pillaging tribal lands in their search for riches.

title: The Return of Sabata
description: The third in a trilogy about the eponymous lone gunman, this one finds Sabata (Lee Van Cleef) working as a sharpshooter for a circus that's just stopped in an ailing one-horse town. The circus gig is only a front, however: Sabata is actually on the verge of robbing town mayor Joe McIntock (Giampiero Albertini). The mayor's been levying heavy taxes as part of a complex plan to defraud the community, but Sabata manages to rip him off first, only to discover that the money is counterfeit.

title: The Deadly Trackers
description: Sean Kilpatrick (Richard Harris), a pacifist border-town sheriff, has used some unconventional methods to keep order in his tiny Texas town. But Kilpatrick's belief system is rocked when the villainous Frank Brand (Rod Taylor) and his gang murder Kilpatrick's family following a bank robbery that goes wrong. An enraged Kilpatrick trails the gang into Mexico, where he partners with local police officer Gutierrez (Al Lettieri) to bring down Brand once and for all.
